messages:
maya: Noticed several backup snapshot uploads failed during last night's rotation window. Getting KMS denies referencing a deleted grant. Anyone triaging?
alex: I saw those around 02:16 UTC. Error in uploader logs: AccessDenied "MissingGrantToken: grant not found" for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01.
luis: Cross-checked CloudTrail: grant g-12f4a7 removed on 2024-03-31T23:58:00Z. The grant's TTL was 7d. Seems archive rotation used a template that creates short-lived grants.
maya: That TTL is new. We expect archive uploads to use long-lived grants. Who changed the infra template?
security-bot: Policy change detected: infra-template PR#514 merged 2024-03-02 introduced `grant_ttl` default to 7 days for temporary grants.
sre_lead: Impact: during rotation, some uploads still referencing old grant IDs which expired mid-upload. Short term: recreate a grant for that CMK and requeue failed uploads. Mid term: change templates so only restore jobs get ephemeral grants.
alex: Created temp grant and requeued failed jobs. Command: aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name uploader-temp
luis: Requeue worked; uploads are succeeding now. We should record the manual grant creation in audit ticket.
maya: I'll open an incident ticket and draft a short postmortem. Proposed fixes: 1) revert grant_ttl default to null for archive-related templates, 2) add CI check to disallow grant_ttl for roles with tag archive:true, 3) enhance KMS audit parser to emit alerts when grant TTL < 30d on CMKs used by long-running jobs.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: backup-uploader service healthy, failures down to 0.
security-bot: Compliance requirement: persist CloudTrail evidence and link manual grant ops to SEC-2024-115. Retain logs for 90 days for this key.
sre_lead: Assignments: alex -> infra PR to change default, luis -> update KMS audit parser alerts, maya -> postmortem and incident ticket with CloudTrail IDs. Follow-up 24h.
maya: Added timeline + CloudTrail IDs to SEC-2024-115 and linked PR after opening. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
